git_rationale.root_cause_commit: 76b5cec3 - feat: add Happy MCP server for Claude-driven title management
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: The MCP handler was designed to send a summary message as a side effect (via sendClaudeSessionMessage) which internally triggered updateMetadata in a fire-and-forget manner. The handler returned success before the metadata was persisted, and any errors from updateMetadata were silently swallowed by .catch().
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Handler now calls updateMetadata directly (not via sendClaudeSessionMessage side effect) and awaits it. If updateMetadata fails (version mismatch, socket disconnect, server error), the handler returns isError:true with the error message. The chat service message is sent only after successful persistence.
